reason: The plugin configures and transmits spoofed Claude Code, Codex, or custom client-identity headers for llm-pi-ai providers, with persistent settings changes, adapter patching, and real upstream test calls; human review is appropriate.

summaries.zh: 为 llm-pi-ai 自定义提供商配置并发送 Claude Code、Codex 或自定义客户端身份请求头，支持设置页、工具操作和测试调用。
summaries.en: Configures and sends Claude Code, Codex, or custom client-identity headers for llm-pi-ai providers, with settings controls, tool actions, and test calls.

capabilities: Persists configuration changes in the profile settings
Applies and reverts a patch to the llm-pi-ai adapter files
Sends a real test request to an upstream gateway
Allows custom client-identity headers, including Claude Code and Codex presets
